lockMinutes.title: Keep a deal price in the cart for (minutes)
lockMinutes.description: Each cart line keeps the deal price it was quoted for this long, even if the deal ends or changes meanwhile (not when it is deleted or used up). 0 = off.

shopperChoice.title: Shoppers pick the deal
shopperChoice.description: When several deals fit a cart line, the shopper picks one; otherwise the best saving applies.

lineChoice.title: Deal a cart line takes
lineChoice.description: best: the largest saving (then the higher priority). first: the first deal in your deals' show order that saves something. A deal the shopper picked wins either way.

cartOffer.title: Checkout deals with item deals
cartOffer.description: How checkout deals (off the cart total, or free delivery) combine with item deals. per_line_best: each line takes the best of its item and checkout deals, and the best free delivery is added. one_after_items: at most one checkout deal, the first live one in your deals' show order that applies, taken off what is left after the item deals (free delivery counts as that deal). one_exclusive: the same, but none once an item deal applies.

cartThresholdBase.title: Checkout deals' minimum cart total is judged on
cartThresholdBase.description: goods: the goods before any deal. after_item_deals: the goods after the item deals (a cart that item deals bring below a checkout deal's minimum does not get it).

rounding.title: Rounding of deal discounts
rounding.description: per_unit_down: each deal is rounded down on each unit (on each line for checkout deals). total_half_up: each deal is worked out on the line or cart amount and the order's deal discounts are rounded once, half up (with whole units, 7% off 4,999 is 350, not 349).
